name: Spearphishing Attachment
summary: Adversaries may use a spearphishing attachment, a variant of spearphishing, as a form of a social engineering attack against specific targets. Spearphishing attachments are different from other forms of spearphishing in that they employ malware attached to an email. All forms of spearphishing are electronically delivered and target a specific individual, company, or industry. In this scenario, adversaries attach a file to the spearphishing email…

analytics.name: Analytic 1913
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an email client process on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux workstation spawning a child process inconsistent with normal email handling. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

analytics.name: Analytic 2241
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) field device or embedded engineering terminal receiving malformed or exploit-payload data via its built-in communication interface from an external source, designed to exploit a vulnerability in the device's communication stack. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

analytics.name: Analytic 2277
